scenes: Two guys made a coin as a joke.
It grew to over eighty-five billion dollars.
December twenty thirteen. Billy Markus and Jackson Palmer launched Dogecoin.
The logo? A Shiba Inu dog named Kabosu.
Fans raised thirty-six thousand dollars in two days. For Jamaica's bobsled team.
Then they sponsored a NASCAR car.
In twenty fifteen, Jackson Palmer quit crypto.
Then twenty twenty-one. Elon Musk kept tweeting about it.
In May, the joke coin passed eighty-five billion dollars.
Then Musk hosted Saturday Night Live.
During the show, it fell almost thirty percent.
